scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sunder/sdk && npm run build --workspace @sunder/package-tool && npm run build --workspace create-sunder-package
scripts.templates:generate: node packages/package-tool/dist/cli.js generate --project packages/create-sunder-package/template && node packages/package-tool/dist/cli.js generate --project packages/create-sunder-package/template-react-node
scripts.templates:typecheck: npm run templates:generate && tsc -p packages/create-sunder-package/template/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/create-sunder-package/template-react-node/tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p packages/create-sunder-package/template-react-node/tsconfig.browser.json
scripts.test: node --test ../../../scripts/test/release/*.test.mjs ../../../scripts/test-oracles/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @sunder/sdk && npm run test --workspace @sunder/package-tool && npm run test --workspace create-sunder-package && npm run templates:typecheck
